illustration.captionEn: My little sister loves to feed the ducks at the park.
illustration.captionZh: 我妹妹很喜歡在公園餵鴨子。

illustration.captionEn: She keeps all her old photos in a file on her computer.
illustration.captionZh: 她把所有舊照片都存在電腦裡的一個檔案中。

illustration.captionEn: She picked a fresh flower from the garden for her mother.
illustration.captionZh: 她從花園裡摘了一朵新鮮的花要送給媽媽。
